title: Adding Instructions during Pretraining: Effective Way of Controlling Toxicity in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language model generations on the RealToxicityPrompts dataset using the Perspective API to calculate Expected Maximum Toxicity and Toxicity Probability.

Performing 32-shot classification on four social bias detection tasks (from Social Bias Frames) to predict if text is offensive, an intentional insult, contains lewd language, or is offensive to a group or an individual.
